definitions.de: Zu/an/gegenüber/pro; eine Präposition, die Richtung, Verbindung, Fortsetzung oder ein Verhältnis ausdrückt
definitions.en: To/towards/per/against; a preposition expressing direction, connection, continuation, or a ratio between things
definitions.es: A/hacia/por/contra; preposición que expresa dirección, conexión, continuación o una relación entre cosas
definitions.fr: À/vers/par/contre; préposition exprimant la direction, la connexion, la continuation ou un rapport entre les choses
definitions.hi: की ओर/प्रति/के विरुद्ध; एक पूर्वसर्ग जो दिशा, संबंध, निरंतरता या अनुपात व्यक्त करता है
definitions.ja: ～へ/～に対して/～につき/続ける；方向・関係・継続・比率を表す前置詞
definitions.km: ទៅ/ឆ្ពោះ/ក្នុងមួយ/ប្រឆាំង; ធ្នាក់ដែលបញ្ជាក់ទិសដៅ ការតភ្ជាប់ ការបន្ត ឬសមាមាត្រ
definitions.ko: ~에게/~를 향해/~당/~에 대해; 방향, 연결, 계속 또는 비율을 나타내는 전치사
definitions.ne: तिर/प्रति/अनुसार; दिशा, सम्बन्ध, निरन्तरता वा अनुपात व्यक्त गर्ने परसर्ग
definitions.pt: Para/em direção a/por/contra; preposição que expressa direção, conexão, continuação ou uma proporção
definitions.th: ไปยัง/ต่อ/ถึง; คำบุพบทที่แสดงทิศทาง การเชื่อมต่อ การต่อเนื่อง หรืออัตราส่วน
definitions.tl: Patungo sa/para sa/bawat; isang prepositional na nagpapahayag ng direksyon, koneksyon, pagpapatuloy, o ratio
definitions.ur: کی طرف/فی/کے خلاف؛ ایک حرف جر جو سمت، تعلق، تسلسل یا تناسب ظاہر کرتا ہے
definitions.vi: Đến/về phía/mỗi/với; giới từ diễn đạt hướng, sự kết nối, sự tiếp tục hoặc tỉ lệ giữa các sự vật
definitions.zh: 向/对/每/继续；表示方向、关系、延续或比例的介词
definitions.zh_Hant: 向/對/每/繼續；表示方向、關係、延續或比例的介詞

definition_en: To/towards/per/against; a preposition expressing direction, connection, continuation, or a ratio between things
